annotations.title: Ask a candidate to fix their CV

description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in, and a verified referrer account. Asks the candidate to fix their CV before the request goes on. The candidate is notified with the tags and note given and can send a fixed CV back. Use it instead of decline_referral_request when the candidate fits but the CV does not show it.

feedback_note.description: Optional note for the candidate, up to 300 characters.

feedback_tags.description: Required: 1 to 3 of missing_keywords (Thiếu từ khoá theo mô tả job); missing_impact (Thiếu số liệu hoặc kết quả cụ thể); seniority_mismatch (Kinh nghiệm chưa khớp level của job); too_long_or_messy (CV quá dài hoặc khó đọc); missing_links (Thiếu link GitHub hoặc portfolio); outdated (Thông tin đã cũ).

name: request_cv_changes

action.description: The action that was applied: claim, release, referred, decline or request_changes.

status_label.description: The new status as techjobs.vn shows it (Vietnamese).
